name: Tanfac Industries Limited
about: Tanfac Industries Limited produces and sells fluorine chemicals in India. The company provides anhydrous and dilute hydrofluoric and sulphuric acid, oleum, aluminium and potassium fluoride, potassium bifluoride, boron trifluoride complexes, calcium sulphate, isobutyl acetophenone, acetic, peracetic acid, sodium silcofluoride, and poly aluminium chloride, etc. It also exports its products. Tanfac Industries Limited was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Chennai, India.
